name: Badhaus
beschreibung: The Badhaus in Söll is a hotel that offers its guests accommodation in the Tirol region. Söll lies in the Sölllandl, a part of the Tiroler Unterland. The hotel is located near the Wilder Kaiser. The facilities are geared toward the needs of vacationers. Various room categories are available. A culinary offering complements the accommodation. The property is suitable as a starting point for activities in the surrounding area.
